create_resource_download: create a Resource object to represent a downloadable file with URL and extraction method
build_extract_method_guess: build extraction method from file extension like .tar.gz, .zip, or .bz2
test_url_sanitize: test URL sanitization that shortens and cleans URLs for safe filesystem naming
run_get_dl_fname: run get_dl_fname to generate a deterministic download filename from URL and SHA256 checksum
review_resource_exists: review Resource.exists_locally to check if a downloaded resource and its INFO file exist on disk
